summary: Add an experimental deterministic readiness planner; native Rebalancer remains an assignment solver, coordinator remains the actual agent dispatcher, and scientific acceptance remains separately evidenced.

restrictions: No arbitrary eval, shell snippets, JSONPath expressions or autonomous dispatch

verifiedSourceFacts.finding: Replay prints receipt-derived metrics and inventory/graph/lineage; technical execution is distinct from geometry/ownership acceptance. Historical lengths are documentation, not admissible new evidence.

Lineage already separates execution, target fingerprint, evidence freshness and acceptance; duplicate joins/missing hashes can remain UNKNOWN. Planner must reject duplicate IDs rather than silently relying on Map last-write behavior.
Compiler checks provider base, ordered stages, single Part producers, missing/forward dependencies and unknown lanes; scope is declared Stage boundaries, not complete native inner Calculations.
Current producer accepts only IMG_5641/badge-9/tee-7 and baseline or heading. No other specimen or generic CV execution can be inferred.

make_state accepts kind=extract only; auto reviews can be disabled. Only native kind=review waits on done and excludes extractor; arbitrary extract dependencies are ignored. finish validates receipt envelope, not scientific validity.
Native assignment is independently checked for worker-set, capacities, pins, eligibility, native constraint counts and exact maximum score before dispatch recommendation.

State is an argument; testimony is optional/impeachable; judge agreement is not acceptance; protected platform files require requests, and prototypes can live outside them. Active doctrine retires default-OFF lanes, whereas pinned historical compiler requires OFF: planner must not reconcile by editing either system.

actualNativeProbe.limitation: Replay of copied scheduling state only. Actual agents were active while shared native worker records remained empty; this proves solver execution, never current worker availability or new scientific support.

prototype.entrypoint: node experiments/capability-discovery/plan.mjs --policy POLICY --state CURRENT_STATE --artifacts ARTIFACT_ROOT --out PLAN
inputs: Immutable versioned policy with expected source commit, closed command IDs, protocol hashes, task DAG, cycle/time budgets and fixed typed guards
Fresh shared state revision plus canonical digest, task attempts/outcomes, coordinator-supplied actual worker/agent/lease registry, claim records and immutable receipt index

Source-bound artifacts read and hashed under an allowlisted root; expected closure fingerprint, input/image/source hashes, recipe/args/tick identity, executable hash and validator protocol are required

fields: taskStatuses[] with ready|blocked|terminal|invalid plus reason codes
outputs.sideEffects: Planner reads source/artifacts and writes only its report/spec. No source edits, state advancement, start/finish, agent API or daemon.

algorithm: Validate schema, allowed fields/ops/command IDs, unique IDs, referenced tasks/bundles/protocols, acyclic needs graph, policy hash and pinned source identity before guard evaluation.
Read one immutable snapshot; reconcile coordinator leases and actual active agents against native state. An unacknowledged active agent blocks capacity rather than being assumed free.

Rehash artifact bytes, decode receipt schemas and reconstruct full binding. Missing/stale evidence is nonauthorizing; source or identity contradiction is an integrity blocker. A claimed successful validation record must itself have current hashed evidence and the pinned validator protocol.

For every predefined task evaluate needs plus typed guards against the same fresh global snapshot. Completed task instance is terminal; impossible branch or exhausted budget is terminal with reason; unmet guards/dependencies/capacity are blocked; malformed policy/state is invalid; otherwise ready. A failed attempt may enable a distinct repair task without becoming successful.
Expand task instances by hash(policy, logical task, exact input bindings, cycle). This allows intentional retries with new inputs while preventing duplicate dispatch of one instance.

Emit native spec containing only ready tasks and actual free registered worker IDs. Semantic review nodes are explicit extract entries with semantic_kind=review, bundle/protocol bindings and allow_workers excluding every producing worker. Set review_policy.enabled=false; no hidden auto-review duplicates.

Run the pinned probe init/solve on fresh epoch-local paths only when spec has workers and jobs. Coordinator must validate returned assignment and atomically reserve task+worker using stateHash/lease compare-and-swap, recheck guards, then invoke actual spawn/followup and acknowledge start. Changed state cancels the recommendation and replans.

After each validated completion, ingest immutable receipt exactly once under the single coordinator writer and immediately rerun from fresh state. Hourly resume uses the same entrypoint plus lease reconciliation; it is a wake trigger, not a continuously running agent claim.
prototype.persistence: Immutable receipts/plans plus a single atomic state-pointer writer; recommendation file alone cannot commit scientific state or consume capacity.

guardSemantics.taskOutcome: Requires latest current task-instance receipt, terminal technical outcome and validated envelope; older attempt outcomes cannot match.
guardSemantics.claimState: Requires an explicit scoped claim record; absence is unknown, never supported. accepted requires a separate protocol-bound decision record, never job done.
guardSemantics.evidenceStatus: Computed by planner from bytes and complete current binding, not trusted from a caller-provided boolean. Freshness is dependency identity, not file mtime or elapsed age alone.
guardSemantics.independentReview: Requires accepted protocol decision on the exact bundle hash by an actually distinct worker/agent principal; review record and its evidence must be current, valid and unique. Exclude all producers, not merely the last writer.
guardSemantics.combination: All guards are AND; alternative recipes are separate predefined task nodes. No string expressions or arbitrary code. Unknown/data missing yields blocked; malformed contradictions yield invalid; not_current branches may enable refresh without enabling retain.

literalExample.note: Illustrative excerpt; referenced replay/candidate tasks and command/protocol registry must exist in the complete policy. No example is executable authority.

jobs.subject: Validate exact candidate bundle using protocol s7-acceptance@1; producer W2 excluded.

nativeReadySpecExample.note: Only emit this shape if coordinator just proved W1/W3 available; no claim is made that they are currently free. Semantic review uses extract transport; scientific validator must enforce its own richer receipt. Per-job review priority is unavailable in this wrapper; batch priority can use extract_priority or selection order outside it.

If W2 is running, missing replay means wait for that lease. If no live producer exists, missing/stale/unvalidated bundle enables refresh. Failed technical replay enables repair; it never proves the route hypothesis false.

failureModes: Stale scheduling state can schedule already-active agents; coordinator registry reconciliation is mandatory.
A native done receipt is only task bookkeeping, and auto review accepted is not a geometry/ownership verdict.
Two simultaneous writers can overwrite atomic-renamed state files despite each write being atomic; use a single writer/lock plus CAS.
Any source-bound receipt must be rehashed and validated; claimed validation booleans are not authority.
Duplicate IDs, reused receipt paths or aliased producer identities can fabricate independence unless checked before joins.
Tasks chosen in advance may be obsolete at completion; reevaluate entire predefined task set from the new global state each time.
Scheduled hourly wake does not guarantee uninterrupted agent availability; report actual last completed cycle and blocked reason.
